scheme_official_name: Production Linked Incentive Scheme (PLI) for Large Scale Electronics Manufacturing
ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
cabinet_approval: 2020-03-20 (per MeitY notification of 23.09.2021: 'approved by Union Cabinet on 20.03.2020'); corresponding PIB release PRID 1607487 carries a posting date of 2020-03-21, most likely a next-day posting rather than a factual conflict - cite the gazette date and note the posting date
application_window: Round 1 closed 2020-07-31 (opening date NOT STATED in the gazette - the text says only 'open for applications for a period of 4 months initially'); Round 2 (specified electronic components) 2021-03-11 to 2021-03-31
first_incremental_sales_year: FY2020-21 (Year 1); electable as FY2021-22 under the 23.09.2021 amendment
primary_Ds_rationale: UNIQUE CASE - the gazette itself names an operational date distinct from any fiscal-year boundary. Para 10.5 verbatim: 'Incentives under the Scheme will be applicable from 01.08.2020.' This appears in the ORIGINAL 1 April 2020 notification, not in a later amendment. It is the earliest date from which incremental sales accrue toward a claim, which is the principle applied uniformly across all four sectors. NOTE the 23.09.2021 amendment lets approved companies ELECT any 5 consecutive years between FY2020-21 and FY2025-26 - an applicant election, NOT a blanket shift of Year 1.
sensitivity_date_2: 2021-08 (elected Year 1 under the 23.09.2021 amendment; also serves as the COVID-robustness intervention date since it moves the break clear of the lockdown rebound)

scheme_official_name: Production Linked Incentive Scheme (PLI) for Pharmaceuticals [with the earlier PLI for promotion of domestic manufacturing of critical KSMs/Drug Intermediates/APIs as the companion scheme]
ministry: Department of Pharmaceuticals (Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers)
cabinet_approval: 2021-02-24 (Pharmaceuticals PLI, PIB PRID 1700433); the bulk-drugs PLI gazette says 'approved by the Government of India on 20th March, 2020' - Government-approval wording, not explicitly 'Cabinet', so labelling it a Cabinet date overstates the source
notification_ref: Gazette No. 76, CG-DL-E-03032021-225603, No. 31026/60/2020-Policy-DoP; bulk drugs Gazette No. 172, CG-DL-E-21072020-220616, No. 31026/16/2020-Policy
guidelines_date: 2021-06-01 (Pharmaceuticals operational guidelines; corrigenda 30.06.2021, 13.08.2021, 20.10.2022, 17.03.2023, 20.10.2023, 11.03.2024); 2020-10-29 (bulk drugs revised guidelines)
application_window: NOT ESTABLISHED for the Pharmaceuticals PLI; the bulk-drugs window was 120 days from notification ('The application window for receiving the applications shall be 120 days')
operational_effective_date: No separate 'effective from' clause. Pharmaceuticals PLI para 3.8: scheme duration FY2020-21 to FY2028-29, comprising application processing (FY2020-21), an optional one-year gestation (FY2021-22), six incentive years, and FY2028-29 for disbursal
primary_Ds_rationale: Both schemes begin paying on incremental sales in FY2022-23. Pharmaceuticals PLI para 3.3: the incentive 'on incremental sales (over base year) of pharmaceutical goods covered under Category 1 & 2 will be 10% for FY 2022-23 to FY 2025-26'. Bulk-drugs PLI para 4.2: chemical-synthesis products incentivised 'for FY 2022-23 to FY 2027-28'. April 2022 is the first month of that first performance year. Choosing the notification date instead would place the break thirteen months before any incremental sale could be claimed.
sensitivity_date_2: 2023-04 (fermentation-route first incentive year per bulk-drugs para 4.1 - relevant only if an API basket is added)

scheme_official_name: Production Linked Incentive Scheme (PLI) for White Goods (Air Conditioners and LED Lights) Manufacturers in India
operational_effective_date: First year of INVESTMENT is FY2021-22 (explicitly distinct from the sales year)
base_year: FY2019-20 - NOT FY2020-21. The 16.08.2021 corrigendum only lets applicants who pre-qualified on FY2020-21 audited financials use the HIGHER of FY2019-20 or FY2020-21 as the sales comparator
primary_Ds_rationale: Notification para 4.2 verbatim: 'The first year of investment will be FY 2021-22 and the first year of incremental sale will be FY 2022-23.' The scheme itself draws the distinction between the investment year and the sales year, so the incremental-sales year is the unambiguous binding date and requires no interpretation.
sensitivity_date_1: 2021-04 (first investment year - tests whether capacity build-out moved exports before the sales incentive began)
sensitivity_date_2: 2023-04 (FY2023-24 for applicants electing the two-year gestation option)

scheme_official_name: Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for Textiles
cabinet_approval: NOT STATED on any primary source. PIB announced the approval on 2021-09-08 (PRID 1753118) but neither the release nor the notification gives a calendar approval date. Do not assert '8 September 2021' as a Cabinet date - only the PIB posting date is verifiable
notification_ref: F. No. 12015/03/2020-IT; notification para 10: 'This notification shall come into force from the date of issuance.' Subsequent amending notifications 2022-02-22, 2023-06-09, 2024-10-09, 2025-02-24, 2025-10-09 (corrigendum 2025-11-03)
operational_effective_date: 2021-09-24 (notification in force from date of issuance); gestation period FY2022-23 to FY2023-24 per para 6
base_year: NO BASE YEAR - the scheme pays 15% (Part-1) or 11% (Part-2) on absolute turnover attained in Year 1 and on >=25% incremental turnover over the immediately preceding year in Years 2-5. Any claim that this scheme has a 'base year 2019-20' is unsupported by the notification
primary_Ds_rationale: Notification para 7 framework table: performance year 1 = FY2024-2025 with claim year FY2025-2026, through performance year 5 = FY2028-2029. Gestation runs FY2022-23 to FY2023-24 (para 6) and is explicitly a build period, not a performance period. April 2024 is the first month of the first performance year.
sensitivity_date_2: 2022-04 (start of the two-year gestation period - the date from which qualifying investment had to begin)

scheme_official_name: Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme to Promote Telecom and Networking Products Manufacturing in India
notification_ref: Gazette Extraordinary Part I Sec.1 No. 68, CG-DL-E-24022021-225442, F.No. 13-01/2020-IC
application_window: 2021-06-04 to 2021-07-03 (PIB PRID 1724121). The widely repeated '1 April to 3 May 2021' window is WRONG - 1 April 2021 is the EFFECTIVE date, not the application window
operational_effective_date: 2021-04-01 (notification para 6: 'The scheme will be effective from 1st April, 2021')
base_year: FY2019-20 for sales; investment baseline as on 2021-03-31
primary_Ds_rationale: Dropped at the sector-selection stage. Recorded here so the exclusion is documented and the dates are preserved if the sector is ever revisited. Reasons: (1) HS-8 line selection is analyst judgement - the notification lists PRODUCTS, not codes; (2) 36 pre-months support at most 1 rolling-origin validation at h=12, so the forecasting counterfactual cannot be validated; (3) the basket is heading 8517 minus the phone lines, which OVERLAPS basket B1 in the same HS-4 heading with a different intervention date.
